entries.title: GCC logistics analytics non-compete for Protected Customers
entries.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates may not directly or indirectly provide Logistics Analytics Services to any Protected Customer anywhere in the GCC during the term and for 24 months after its expiry or termination.
entries.quote: during the term of this Agreement and for twenty-four (24) months after its expiry or termination, the Supplier shall not, and shall procure that its Affiliates shall not, directly or indirectly, provide Logistics Analytics Services to any Protected Customer anywhere in the Territory, whether as contractor, subcontractor, partner or adviser.

counterparties: Doha Bay Container Terminal Services W.L.L.

relatedClauses.quote: "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, including any parent, subsidiary or sister company wherever incorporated.

"Logistics Analytics Services" means fleet utilisation, route optimisation, warehouse performance, port-turnaround, freight demand forecasting and similar data analytics or data engineering services for freight, shipping, warehousing or logistics operations.
"Protected Customer" means each person listed in Schedule 4, and any of its Affiliates.
"Territory" means the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council.
